rows.question: Why can the same 30-day fill cost more at a standard pharmacy than a preferred one on this plan?
rows.answer: Preferred retail and standard retail use different cost-share categories, so the pharmacy’s dated network classification on the fill date determines which category applies rather than a change to the prescription. For the recorded matched 30-day metformin 500 mg supply, this plan’s cost share is $8 at preferred retail and $27 at standard retail under the recorded conditions.
